source.publication: 2025 Complete Income Tax Instruction Booklet (ip25), Kansas Department of Revenue, with Form K-40 and Schedule S bound in (PDF pages 19-22)
source.section: Form K-40 lines 1-12 (ip25 PDF page 20; exemption block PDF page 19); K-40 instructions lines 1-3 (PDF page 6), line 4 and exemptions (PDF page 6), lines 5-8 (PDF page 7); Schedule S line A14 (ip25 PDF page 21), instructions PDF page 12 'Retirement benefits specifically exempt from Kansas Income Tax', second bullet; tax rate schedule: 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 34) and Tax Table (PDF pages 27-34)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (spouse) 50,000.00 + railroad retirement benefit (you) 30,000.00 = 80,000.00. Federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 (31,500.00) = 48,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Kansas starts from federal AGI). Schedule S Part A: line A1 0.00; lines A2-A8 0.00; line A9 total additions 0.00. Line A10 0.00; lines A11-A13 0.00; line A14 retirement benefits specifically exempt: U.S. Railroad Retirement Board benefits (you) 30,000.00 = 30,000.00; lines A15-A25 0.00; line A26 total subtractions = 30,000.00; line A27 net modification = 0.00 - 30,000.00 = -30,000.00. Form K-40: line 1 federal AGI 80,000.00; line 2 modifications -30,000.00; line 3 Kansas AGI = 80,000.00 + (-30,000.00) = 50,000.00; line 4 standard deduction (married filing joint) 8,240.00; line 5 exemption allowance (2 exemptions) 18,320.00, 0 dependents; line 6 total deductions = 8,240.00 + 18,320.00 = 26,560.00; line 7 taxable income = 50,000.00 - 26,560.00 = 23,440.00; line 8 tax (rate schedule as numbers, PDF page 34): 5.2% x 23,440.00 = 1,218.8800 = 1,218.88. Line 7 is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 23,401-23,450, married filing joint column, PDF page 28, gives 1,218; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 9-10 do not apply (resident); line 11 0.00; line 12 total income tax 1,218.88. Credits (lines 13-15, 17): none, 0.00; state income tax = 1,218.88. Age 62: no age test. The source in the inputs is private, but the railroad entry follows the kind, not the source.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rates, not the printed tables and rounded worksheet subtraction.
